items.title: 2.3 Ilm ki numaindagi ke dhaanche ke taur par mantiq (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: topic 2.3 with its Tidbit and Class Activity (PDF 26-27, printed 22-23).

blocks.text: Logic sahi tarah sochne (true reasoning) ka ilm hai aur computer science ka ek aham concept hai. Yeh computers ko maloomat (information) sahi tarah store karne, samajhne aur istemal karne mein madad deti hai. Logic ki madad se mushkil maloomat ko aasan tareeqe se likha aur dikhaya ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Logic computers ko facts ke baare mein “sochne” aur faisle karne ka tareeqa deti hai, taqreeban dimagh (brain) ki tarah.

Computer science mein logic ka matlab hai qaidon (rules) ke mutabiq sahi faisle karna. Logic computers ko sach (true) aur jhoot (false) wali conditions (shartein) samajhne mein madad deti hai. Is se system maloomat ko sahi tarah process karta hai. Logical statements programs aur algorithms mein istemal hote hain. Yeh statements program ka flow (kaun sa hissa kab chale) control karte hain. Computer ke bohat se kaamon ki bunyad logic hai. Is se computer ek tarteeb (structured way) se sochta hai.
Reasoning aur faisla karne mein logic ka kirdar

Reasoning (daleel se sochna) aur faisla karne mein logic ka bara kirdar hai. Yeh computers aur insaanon dono ko sahi nateeja (conclusion) nikalne mein madad deti hai. Logic se faisle facts aur qaidon ki bunyad par hote hain. Is se uljhan aur andaze (guesswork) khatam ho jate hain. Logical reasoning masle ko qadam ba qadam hal karti hai. Computer sahi kaam chunne ke liye logic istemal karte hain. Logic faislon ko hamesha ek jaisa (consistent) aur durust (accurate) rakhti hai. Yeh expert systems aur artificial intelligence (AI) mein istemal hoti hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text:
• Baat karein ke logic faisle karne mein kaise madad deti hai.
• Students school ki zindagi ke baare mein aasan “if-then” (agar-to) jumle banayein.
• Misal: “Agar barish hui, to hum andar rahenge.”

blocks.prompt: Computer science mein logic kya hai? Ek if-then qaida batayein jo koi program istemal kar sakta hai.
blocks.explanation: Qaidon ke mutabiq sach ya jhoot dekh kar sahi faisle karna, jo program ka flow control karte hain. Misal: agar password sahi hai to account kholo, warna error dikhao.

items: Logic: sahi tarah sochne ka ilm; mushkil maloomat aasan tareeqe se dikhati hai.
Programs mein logical statements flow control karte hain.
Logic faisle facts aur qaidon par, ek jaise aur durust banati hai; expert systems aur AI mein istemal.
